facts.label: Hábitos e superlativos
facts.sub: Use o present simple para hábitos: I listen to the radio. Use the + -est para o número um: It’s the best station. Com he, she e it, adicione -s.

facts.label: Hábitos
facts.sub: Use o present simple para hábitos: I listen to the radio. She likes songs. Com he, she e it, adicione -s: he listens, she plays. Use always para dizer que é todo dia.

facts.label: Superlativo
facts.sub: Para dizer o número um, use the + adjetivo-est: the best, the newest, the oldest, the nicest. Exemplo: It’s the oldest radio in Glasgow.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: A superlative says one thing is number one.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: A superlative says one thing is number one. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “the most good song”. → Falso (We say the best song.)
“The funniest” is a superlative. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A warm kitchen · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Tuesday morning in a warm kitchen in Glasgow. Toast and tea sit on the table. Noah turns on an old radio. His friend Dean comes in from the rain. Soft music plays in the room. Dean asks about the radio.
“Noah, what do you listen to in the morning?” says Dean. “I always listen to the radio. It’s the best way to start the day.” says Noah. “Which station do you like?” says Dean.
